name: Total energy consumption per person (million Btu)
line: The US Energy Information Administration’s figure, not the World Bank’s: total energy consumption per person in million Btu, not kilograms of oil equivalent, 1980–2024. The EIA’s file gives 0 for some places and years; VM reads the EIA’s 0 as no value and leaves it blank. The World Bank’s series comes in part from the IEA, another agency counting in another unit, so the two cannot be read one for one.
